chunks: And from him, from al-‘Alā’ ibn Razīn, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abī ‘Abdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The woman in nifās refrains, if the blood does not cease from her, for thirty [or] forty days, up to fifty.

key_terms.النُّفَسَاءُ: a woman in the state of postnatal bleeding

ai.seo_question: How long does a woman in nifās refrain if her bleeding does not stop?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the duration of nifās when postnatal bleeding continues. It indicates that the woman in nifās remains in the state of refraining for thirty or forty days, extending up to fifty days.
